newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai B shares close higher on new listing.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai B shares close higher on new listing.

text.p: Shanghai's foreign currency B shares closed slightly higher on Tuesday, buoyed by the healthy performance of a newly listed company, brokers said.
Shanghai Zhenhua Port Machinery Co Ltd's newly listed B shares staged a respectable debut, ending at $0.480 compared with an offer price of $0.433.
The B share index gained 0.097 points or 0.13 percent to close at 74.481 on volume of 24.349 million shares worth $9.104 million.
Zhenhua Port led the active list with 10.876 million shares changing hands as it ended its first day of trade at $0.48 against its issue price of $0.433.
The company, which makes port handling equipment, issued 100 million B shares raising net proceeds of $41.135 million.
Brokers said the solid performance of the newcomer gave the market a boost, but many investors were waiting to see whether the stock could hold onto its gains in the coming days.
"Some institutions suppported the newcomer," one local broker said. "But its performance in the coming days is uncertain."
Other brokers said the continued rise of the Hong Kong market was drawing attention away from B shares.
"Foreign institutional investors are still focusing their buying on Hong Kong, so the (Shanghai) B share market won't stage a sharp upward run soon," said another broker.
Despite the slight rise in the index, losers outnumbered gainers. Of the 46 B share issues, 39 were traded with 17 losing ground and 15 advancing. Seven were unchanged.
Shanghai Dazhong Taxi Co was the second sharpest gainer on speculative buying. It rose $0.030 or 3.46 percent to $0.896.
Shanghai Lujiazui Finance & Trade Zone Development Co was the second most actively traded B share on insitutional buying, gaining $0.008 or 0.63 percent to $1.286 on volume of 707,155 shares.
Shanghai's domestic currency A shares fell on a technical correction, but market sentiment was stable, brokers said.
The A index shed 4.406 points or 0.35 percent to 1,251.866 on volume of 328.337 million shares worth 3.406 billion yuan.
The SSE30 blue chip index rose 20.672 points or 0.55 percent to 3,748.033 points.
Shanghai Forever Bicycle Co was the biggest loser on the A share market, falling 1.20 yuan or 9.84 percent to 11.00 yuan.
